<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
This PKGBUILD follows standard AUR packaging practices for bundling a pre-built AppImage into a native Arch package. The sole network operations are downloads from the project's official GitHub releases (the AppImage itself and a LICENSE file), both pinned with explicit SHA-256 checksums. There are no extraneous network requests, no obfuscated or encoded commands, and no exfiltration of local data.

The `prepare()` function runs the AppImage with `--appimage-extract` to unpack the embedded squashfs image – this is the normal mechanism to extract an AppImage's payload without FUSE, not an arbitrary execution of untrusted code. The `package()` function copies the extracted files into the package directory, removes bundled libraries that Arch supplies system-wide, cleans up Windows-specific artifacts and build-host symlinks, and installs desktop integration files. All operations are confined to the package's own installation directories (`$pkgdir`) and the AppImage's extracted content (`$srcdir/squashfs-root/`). There is no evidence of injected malicious code, backdoors, or behavior beyond what is required to repackage the upstream application.
</details>
<evidence></evidence>
